scripts.test:local: rimraf allure-results && cross-env TEST_ENV=local npx playwright test
scripts.test:dev: rimraf allure-results && cross-env TEST_ENV=dev npx playwright test
scripts.test:test: rimraf allure-results && cross-env TEST_ENV=test npx playwright test
scripts.test:visuel: cross-env TEST_ENV=local SLOWMO=1000 npx playwright test --project=structure-app --headed
scripts.report:generate: npm run report:branding && npx allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean --name "ICARE QUALITY"
scripts.report: npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
